semiconductor_relevance: High — Technohands provides specialized automation equipment for handling micro-sized components, which is critical in semiconductor assembly and manufacturing processes.
summary: Technohands develops advanced automation systems designed for the precise handling and transport of micro-sized electronic components, enhancing efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products include systems for micro-positioning and automated picking, which are essential for applications in optical adjustment, medical robotics, and analytical instruments.
capabilities: Micro Parts Picking System (MPPS-251010) for automated recognition and transport of minute parts
Laser micro-hole machining with the LBRS-4M-AB system
Ultrasonic motors for stable transport of delicate components
